title: Customer and item posting fields fit decision
purpose: Decide the next narrow W1 Foundation step from TARGET-042 field evidence before any O2C/P2P document, Preview Posting or Posting.
entryCriteria: TARGET-042 observed U-CUST-100 and U-ITEM-HW100 card contexts read-only in playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
TARGET-042 produced fieldSummary for customer and item.
No setup, master data, document, Preview Posting or Posting was changed by TARGET-042.
acceptanceCriteria: The decision names exactly one next narrow case.
The decision does not unlock O2C/P2P documents.
The decision separates field visibility, missing UI fields and actual setup correctness.
If field visibility is insufficient, the next case is UI/Page Inspection/personalization discovery rather than a write gate.
If setup writes become necessary later, they require a separate Smart Decision with exact fields and values.

nextStepDecisionCard.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-042 observed U-CUST-100 and U-ITEM-HW100 card contexts read-only. Customer posting/VAT/payment fields were not visible in compact card text; item Base Unit, Lagerbuchungsgruppe, Produktbuchungsgruppe and inventory signals were visible, but no setup value correctness is proven.
nextStepDecisionCard.reason: A direct O2C preflight and a field-write case are both premature. The safer and more useful next step is read-only UI discovery of hidden/available fields.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: It can inspect FastTabs, layout, FactBoxes, Page Inspection and personalization read-only before any write.
A write case needs exact field controls and intended values.
O2C still depends on posting/VAT/inventory setup truth.
Vendor numbering remains parked and unrelated to this customer/item field discovery.
Useful cross-check before promoting setup claims, but less direct than the current UI field gap.

queueChangesMade: TARGET-043 completed as local decision gate.
TARGET-044 selected as read-only UI discovery before any field/setup write.
nextStepDecisionCard.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It improves Playwright/BC understanding of cards, FastTabs and field visibility without risking setup or master-data writes.
risksBeforeNextCase: Do not edit customer or item fields.
Do not create documents, Preview Posting or Posting.
Do not claim posting readiness from visibility.
requiredPreparation: Use direct filtered Customer Card Page 21 and Item Card Page 30 URLs.
Capture before/after only for read-only layout states, not data changes.
If personalization/Page Inspection is unstable, stop with screenshot QA and blocker.

decision.reason: TARGET-042 shows card contexts and some labels, but missing customer posting/VAT/payment fields and missing item VAT/costing signals may be caused by FastTabs, layout, FactBoxes or personalization. A setup write would be premature.

rejectedRoutes.reason: Exact field controls and target values are not yet proven; writing now would risk wrong fields or false posting-readiness.
O2C still needs customer/item posting fields, VAT boundary and expected entry trace before documents are safe.
Vendor U-VEND route remains separate and blocked; it should not distract from the current customer/item field gap.

target044Scope: Open U-CUST-100 and U-ITEM-HW100 read-only in playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
Inspect FastTabs, visible sections, FactBox influence and page layout without editing.
Use Page Inspection and/or personalization only as read-only discovery if stable and non-destructive.
Capture screenshot QA explaining which fields are visible, hidden or not found.
Do not write customer, item, setup, document, Preview Posting or Posting.
